patch.description: RFC 6902 operations, as JSON text, applied to the live policy; over MCP a user is named by pseudonym, in a file by login

policy.description: the proposed policy as HuJSON text, a top-level object; leave it and patch out to validate the live policy

changes.description: differences from the live policy, by class

dependsOnLiveState.description: the answer depends on the live policy

errors.description: what made the status what it is, placed in the text where possible

kind.description: the kind of finding, as the tool's description lists

line.description: from 1, counting line feeds as Tailscale does; absent when unknown

moreCandidates.description: more places match, past the cap

pointer.description: JSON pointer, when the line is not known

source.description: where the position is: from, against, patch (the patch, or the policy it makes: a pointer), invariants, live or version; empty for a message about the text as a whole

existingWarnings.description: warnings the live policy already has

externallyManaged.description: true, false or unknown: managed outside the admin console

identicalToLive.description: the text is byte for byte the live policy

invariantsApplied.description: invariant tests that ran; 0 means none

liveChanged.description: the live policy changed during the check; never a pass

newWarnings.description: warnings the live policy does not already have: one is existing only if it matches a warning stored with the live policy word for word, so a reworded one reads as new

newWarningsOmitted.description: new warnings not listed in newWarnings, past the caps; still new warnings, and part of omitted

kind.description: the kind of finding, as the tool's description lists

line.description: from 1, counting line feeds as Tailscale does; absent when unknown

moreCandidates.description: more places match, past the cap

pointer.description: JSON pointer, when the line is not known

source.description: where the position is: from, against, patch (the patch, or the policy it makes: a pointer), invariants, live or version; empty for a message about the text as a whole

omitted.description: problems left out past the caps

patchedBytes.description: for a patch: its size once applied, as acl_get shows a policy (while personal data is masked, the masked text)

patchedDigest.description: for a patch, with a privacy key: acl_get's summary semanticDigest equals it once the live policy means this

policySha256.description: SHA-256 of the live policy as acl_get shows it

policyVersion.description: live policy version: a keyed digest of its ETag, or the ETag with personalData show; absent otherwise

serverChecked.description: false: the text was not sent to Tailscale, so a pass is a local one

serverErrors.description: errors stored with the live policy

status.description: pass, fail (a test failed), invalid (not a policy), rejected (by Tailscale), unresolved (a test names what Tailscale cannot resolve) or unknown (an answer not recognised, or the live policy changed): unknown is not a pass

testsBefore.description: in the live policy; 0 when not read

validatedLive.description: true: no policy and no patch was given, so what was validated is the live policy itself (an empty policy is no policy)
